Executive White Sprinter

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The Executive White Sprinter is the Executive Black in white: the same fourteen black-on-black leather shuttle seats, high quality, each one reclining on its own with its own cup holder. Extremely spacious, with room for forty bags in the back.

About the Executive White Sprinter

Mood ambient lighting in the roof and through the cabin, and a custom sound system with a subwoofer. White photographs beautifully at a wedding and reads clean at a corporate pickup.

The one we recommend for weddings and formal settings, executive groups, golf outings, tours, and the casual night out where you do not need to go all out.

Seats: Black-on-black leather shuttle seats, each reclining on its own

Executive White Sprinter rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $145 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $295. Seats 14, room for 40 bags.

How it works on the day

Good to know. Bottled water is on board and it is the only complimentary amenity; everything else is an add-on you choose at checkout.

  • Where we meet you: Put a street address on the reservation rather than a landmark, and give us the mobile number of whoever is actually meeting the vehicle — on a wedding day that is the planner or a groomsman, not the couple. Your chauffeur photographs the interior before every trip for our records.
  • Luggage: Luggage loads into the rear compartment on this Sprinter, so a full cabin and a full load of bags can travel together. Garment bags, gift boxes and florals are worth naming on the reservation so we confirm the fit in writing before the day. The Executive White Sprinter is rated for up to 40 bags.
  • What we can and cannot do: Hourly charters on this vehicle start at four hours. Airport and point-to-point transfers are priced as a trip instead, with no hourly minimum: flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and longer transfers priced from the drive with the empty return included. Each extra stop on a transfer is $50. Anything the online quote cannot price — an unusual route, a multi-vehicle movement, a vehicle we hold for request only — goes to the reservations desk and comes back as a written quote before any card is charged.
  • What it costs: 4 hours in the Executive White Sprinter (seats 14): 4 × $145 = $580. Add 8% Arizona tax; there is no booking fee and no fuel fee. How the rest settles depends on how you pay: on a card, a 50% deposit holds the date and your written confirmation sets out the balance and its timing; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk opens that same checkout.
